displayName: OJ — accept → verdict p99 latency > 30 s

documentation.content: End-to-end p99 latency from submission accepted at the API gateway to verdict published on `evaluated_results` is above 30 s, sustained for 5 minutes. The submission funnel dashboard breaks this down into the four span segments — start there. Common causes: sandbox pool depleted (see the sandbox-pool-depth dashboard), Kafka consumer-lag spike on `execution-worker.pretest`, CRDB outbox flush stalled.
